captions.linkedin:
Tailoring a resume to a job usually means an evening of rewording bullet points.

Here's the same job done in about 30 seconds with QuickFit CV:
• Paste the job description and see which of its keywords your resume already has, and which it's missing
• Rewrite only the lines you choose, in the job's own language
• Fit it on one page
• Check it the way an ATS reads it: one column, real text, standard headings, dates on every role

One rule throughout: it never adds a skill, employer, date or number that isn't yours.

Free to try: https://quickfitcv.com
